class.name: CgameAreaLights
class.brief_description: Gives local lights a physical emitter size so their shadows soften with distance.
class.description: [CgameAreaLights] manages the PCSS-style softness of torches, lanterns and campfires. Register an [OmniLight3D] or [SpotLight3D] with its emitter radius using [method register_light]; the radius is applied to [member Light3D.light_size] only on quality level [code]2[/code] and above because the blocker search costs extra texture taps. [method configure] sets the tier, switches the positional shadow filter quality and re-applies all registered lights. Registered lights join the [code]aa_area_light[/code] group and keep their emitter radius in the [code]aa_area_radius[/code] meta entry.

method.name: configure
method.description: Stores [param level] (clamped to [code]0..3[/code]), sets the positional soft shadow filter quality to [method filter_quality] and re-applies the size of every registered light in [param tree]. [param tree] may be [code]null[/code].

method.name: filter_quality
method.description: Returns the [enum RenderingServer.ShadowQuality] used for [param level]: hard, soft low, soft medium and soft high for levels [code]0[/code] to [code]3[/code].

method.name: get_group
method.description: Returns the name of the node group that registered lights belong to.

method.name: get_level
method.description: Returns the level stored by the last [method configure] call.

method.name: get_meta_radius
method.description: Returns the meta key under which a registered light stores its emitter radius.

method.name: register_light
method.description: Registers [param light] with an emitter radius in meters, adds it to the area-light group and applies the size for the current level. Only [OmniLight3D] and [SpotLight3D] receive a size.

method.name: size_for
method.description: Returns the light size actually used: [param emitter_radius] (never negative) for levels [code]2[/code] and above, [code]0.0[/code] below.
